title: Mahjong Yon Shimai: Wakakusa Monogatari
native_title: 麻雀四姉妹 若草物語
overview:
The Saturn's last great adult mahjong game finally arrives!!

The authentic strip mahjong game that made waves in the arcades is already on the Sega Saturn! What's more, it adds graphics that were not in the arcade version - the "final" great adult mahjong game that will move fans to tears!!

サターン最後のH麻雀大作ついに登場!!

アーケードで話題を呼んだ本格脱衣麻雀が早くもセガサターンに登場！しかも業務用版にはなかったグラフィックを追加、ファン感涙の「最後」のH麻雀大作だ!!
